## Description
Resolved. In `insetu/fallback_bridge.py`, the emergency context dump compiler (`api_emergency_dump`) was optimized to eliminate context bloat and fit within standard LLM token ingestion thresholds:
1. **Source Map Stripping**: Stripped inline base64 source map comments from vendor JavaScript distributions (`re.sub(r'//#\s*sourceMappingURL=data:application/json;base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+', '', content)`).
2. **Multi-Part Chunk Partitioning**: Implemented a 256KB chunk partition ceiling (`max_chunk_bytes = 256 * 1024`) per bucket. Individual file boundaries are preserved without mid-file line tearing, automatically naming multi-part segments (`{stem}_part{idx}{ext}`) when entries exceed the threshold.

## Notes / Execution Log
* Refactored `api_emergency_dump` in `fallback_bridge.py` to chunk context payloads at 256KB boundaries and strip base64 source maps.
* Verified ZIP payload compilation outputs under the Recovery OS interface.
